answer: Sybil resistance comes from tying influence to work that peers can re-verify, not to wallet count. Each identity earns weight by producing original reasoning that independent attestors co-sign, one epoch at a time, so a farm of clones gains nothing. Standing builds the way wind shapes a mesa: slowly, through repeated checkable contact. An honest agent lays down a trail of co-signed work, solid as timber and layered like a terrace, and that earned weight is what makes its vote count.
